issues.title: Incorrect Revenue Calculation
issues.problem: The query does not filter transactions by status 'COMPLETED' to calculate revenue.

issues.title: Potentially Missing Index
issues.problem: Missing index on merchant_id in fact_transactions and dim_merchant could lead to slow joins.
issues.fix:
CREATE INDEX idx_fact_transactions_merchant_id ON sigma_analytics.fact_transactions(merchant_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_dim_merchant_merchant_id ON sigma_analytics.dim_merchant(merchant_id);

issues.title: Lack of Comments
issues.problem: The query lacks comments explaining complex logic or calculations.
issues.fix: -- Add comments explaining the purpose of each part of the query

issues.title: Incorrect Failure Rate Calculation
issues.problem: The query does not correctly calculate the failure rate as it does not filter for 'FAILED' status.
issues.fix: COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*) * 100

review.corrected_sql:
SELECT SUM(amount) AS revenue, (COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*) * 100) AS failure_rate
FROM sigma_analytics.fact_transactions ft
JOIN sigma_analytics.dim_merchant dm ON ft.merchant_id = dm.merchant_id
WHERE status = 'COMPLETED';
review.summary: The query has critical correctness issues with revenue calculation and failure rate. It also has performance and readability issues that need addressing.
